question.text: Sortino Ratio differs from Sharpe by using:

answer.text: Downside (semi) standard deviation instead of full SD

explanation.text: The Logic: Sortino = (Rp - Rf) / Downside Deviation. Penalises only downside volatility, not upside — appeals to investors who view risk as loss, not variance. The Trap: Beta belongs to Treynor; tracking error to Information Ratio. Cross-Exam Context: XV, X-A, XVII all mention; XXI-B tests. Manager's Pro-Tip: Sortino particularly useful for asymmetric-return strategies (hedge funds, option-writing) where upside shouldn't be penalised.
